title: Traditional German Pear Crumble
description: A classic German dessert featuring poached pears topped with a crunchy oat and brown sugar crumble.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: for gluten-free, substitute with gluten-free flour

instructions: Peel, core, and halve the pears. Place them in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, oats, and brown sugar. Add the melted butter and mix until crumbly.
Pour the crumble mixture evenly over the pears.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 10-12 minutes, or until the pears are tender.
Transfer the pear mixture to a 9-inch baking dish and top with additional crumble mixture if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the pears are caramelized.
Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired.
